scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix shared install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix scripts/catalog install
scripts.test: npm --prefix shared test && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix scripts/catalog test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shared run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix scripts/catalog run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
